name: energy-market-scraper-gr
title: Hellenic & Balkan Energy Market Tracker - Imbalance & RES Curtailment
description: Unifies Greek and Southeastern European energy market data from ADMIE (IPTO), HEnEx and ENTSO-E into one clean hourly JSON dataset: load, RES generation vs forecast, curtailment volumes, day-ahead clearing prices, system marginal price and cross-border flows, with grid-stress indicators and optional webhook alerts.
